import itertools
# universe of region types over sets C,G,S,M; each region present or absent
regions=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
ok={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
for mask in range(1<<16):
    pres=[r for i,r in enumerate(regions) if mask>>i&1]
    C=[r for r in pres if r[0]];G=[r for r in pres if r[1]];S=[r for r in pres if r[2]];M=[r for r in pres if r[3]]
    if not all([C,G,S,M]): continue
    if not any(r[0] and r[1] for r in pres): continue
    if any(r[1] and r[2] for r in pres): continue
    if any(r[2] and not r[3] for r in pres): continue
    if all(r[2] for r in C): ok['I']=False
    if any(r[3] for r in C): ok['II']=False
    if all(r[1] for r in M): ok['III']=False
follows={k for k,v in ok.items() if v}
opts={'A':{'II','III'},'B':{'I','III'},'C':{'I'},'D':{'I','II','III'}}
assert follows==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert follows!=opts[k]
